name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods by mahboob: output helpers and the token-saving pack.

plugins.name: copy-summary
plugins.description: Readable output style plus auto-copied plain-text summary after tool work.

plugins.name: trim-output
plugins.description: Trims big file, shell and connector output (Haiku notes after a free pre-filter).

plugins.name: effort-tuner
plugins.description: Picks the reasoning effort per prompt; most prompts decided locally.

plugins.name: agent-model-picker
plugins.description: Picks each subagent's model with a Haiku judge and confidence bars.

plugins.name: cache-timer
plugins.description: Prompt cache countdown and a keep-warm that stops at break-even.

plugins.name: chat-handoff
plugins.description: Writes, saves and copies a handoff of a long chat.

plugins.name: trim-web
plugins.description: Shortens big web results, keeping sources and dates.

plugins.name: savings-meter
plugins.description: /savings: tokens saved net of re-reads, with helper cost.

plugins.name: dedupe-reads
plugins.description: Replaces an unchanged repeat file read with a one-line pointer.

plugins.name: test-output-trim
plugins.description: Cuts long test runs to failures and summary; the full log is saved to disk. No model call.

plugins.name: cost-ledger
plugins.description: Side pane over the savings ledger: net savings, helper cost, by plugin.

plugins.name: mahboobmonnamd
plugins.description: Installs the whole token-saving pack in one step.
